local_acceptance_summary.local_browser_producer_difference: The completed local run began before the final metadata-only runtime/log-name prefix correction. Runtime bytes, assertions, report schema and screenshots were unchanged. Final CI executes the corrected producer.
local_acceptance_summary.description: Before a workspace interruption, the complete local source/package suite passed on PHP 8.3.6, including 173 metadata and 412 editorial access assertions. All ten retained HTTP suites, the actual-package MySQL marketing suite (402 checks with an explicitly pinned package), and retained MySQL editorial access (1557 checks per root/nested case) passed. New metadata HTTP passed 1135 checks per file case and 1308 per MySQL case. Four file/MySQL desktop/mobile browser cases passed with 20 screenshots, fitting geometry, decoded images, no JavaScript errors and no SMTP activity. Local MySQL was 8.0.46 with SYSTEM/JST while the site used America/Chicago. The browser producer subsequently received only a log-name isolation correction. The interruption removed temporary raw local reports; these counts are a retained summary of observed execution, not recreated logs. The exact source was recovered from GitHub and all four files rebuilt to their original frozen sizes and SHA-256 hashes. The final GitHub run independently repeats acceptance on the committed producer and supplies the durable raw logs and actual artifacts.
